tools.name: create_chart
tools.description: Create a chart. chartType: ColumnClustered(柱状图), Line(折线图), Pie(饼图), BarClustered(条形图), Area, Scatter. dataRange: value data with header (e.g. B1:B10). labelRange: optional X-axis labels (e.g. A2:A5). palette: optional 墨青/暖砂/霜白/夜航/朱砂 (moqing|nuansha|shuangbai|yehang|zhusha) for series colors.
